user.title: Home Energy Monitor
user.description: Pick the sensors for your installation. Only the grid sensor is required; leave anything you don't have empty.

data_description.grid_power: Net grid power (positive = importing). If you have separate import and export sensors, put the import sensor here.
data_description.grid_export_power: Only if your meter reports export as a separate positive sensor.
data_description.grid_invert: Turn on if your grid sensor is negative while importing.
data_description.battery_power: Positive = discharging, negative = charging (use the invert switch if yours is the other way round).
data_description.battery_invert: Turn on if your battery sensor is positive while charging.
data_description.heat_pump_power: Power used by the heat pump.
data_description.ev_power: Power used by the EV charger.
data_description.price_import: Sensor with the current all-in price per kWh (€/kWh, c€/kWh or €/MWh are converted automatically).
data_description.price_export: Sensor with the current price you receive per exported kWh.

error.duplicate_sensor: This sensor is already used for another field.
error.export_without_import: Set an import price sensor too.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Energy Monitor is already set up.
